Junin virus is able to multiply and produce IF in the brain of mice of all ages studied, and that circulating IF is a good marker of virus multiplication.

in young mice, the virus was detected in brain and circulating IF was found in blood, but no viremia occurred; while in older mice, the virus disappeared from brain, circulating IF disappeared from blood but viremia was detected.

in young mice, Junin virus is capable of multiplying in the brain and inducing viremia.
in mice, as in man, the age is a very important factor to determine the course and outcome of the infection with Junin.
